description.value:
Duration constant

When a Passing you are performing heals and steadies nearby allies, one additional ally within the same area is affected, receiving the same benefit in the same amount. You choose which ally when the Passing begins. This does not increase the amount healed, extend the area, or add a second instance for anyone already benefiting.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is a child of "Warmth Before The Ash," granted by The Hearth (ashcantor.the-hearth.json), whose own system.rules is [] and whose followUp note confirms the healing numbers live in a not-yet-written spell -- there is no existing target-count or area field to add "one more ally" to.
